about: Every asset Scandinavian Flick ships, where it comes from and under what licence. The game ships no audio file, no font file and no texture file: every sound is synthesized and every tree, building and road is geometry built by code at run time. The CARS and the TREES are the models it ships: glTFs made in Blender off the game's own numbers by `make models` (the code-built car and trees are one switch away, VITE_MODEL_CARS=0 / VITE_MODEL_TREES=0). Nothing here is third-party. A new kind of asset, or a new generator, changes this file in the same commit.

Every sound effect, bed and tracker score, as authored synthesis parameters; the shared framework's synth (@niclaslindstedt/oss-game-framework/audio/synth) plays them. No audio file ships.
The world's models and materials — cars, flora, buildings, terrain, sky — built as geometry by this code at run time. No model or texture file ships.

The modelled cars, one per catalog car, made in Blender off the game's own data (the CarBodySpec, the shell's rings, every bolt-on's plan). Committed with pwa/models/sources.json, the stamp tests/models_test.ts holds to their sources.

assets.generator: make models (scripts/blender.mjs, scripts/lib/tree-model-data.mjs, scripts/blender/tree.py, scripts/lib/glb-pack.mjs, scripts/models.mjs)
assets.note: The modelled trees, one glTF per kind (every tree variant the flora plants, each a full tree and a far sketch), made in Blender off the game's own data (the variants' rows and the skeleton the code's recipes lay) and packed with meshopt. Stamped apart in pwa/models/sources.json, which tests/models_test.ts holds to their sources.
